g.text: WebSocket Serving — Upgrade, Subscribe, Live Feed, and Hydration (CP6)
redisSub: SUBSCRIBE only — cannot issue commands.
redis: HGETALL, SCAN, etc — cannot SUBSCRIBE.
Alert events go to all connected clients.
No bbox filter — alerts are global.
On WebSocket disconnect, client re-runs full hydration:
1. GET /entities/live — re-seeds map from Redis live state
2. GET /alerts — re-seeds alert panel from TimescaleDB
3. Open new WebSocket — send subscribe with current bbox
Messages missed during the gap are recovered from
Redis and TimescaleDB, not from pub/sub replay.
